examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Joined actions that share one outline. Give the group a `label` so it is named for assistive technology.

examples.title: Single choice
examples.description: `variant="toggle"` with `value` and `onValueChange` makes a segmented control: one item is selected and a highlight glides between them.

examples.title: Icon only
examples.description: `iconOnly` shows just the icons. Each item's `label` is still its accessible name.

examples.title: With a menu
examples.description: `menu` adds a chevron that opens extra actions, useful when the group has more items than fit.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disable the whole group, or a single item.
